query:
DEFINE
    VAR _entity = TREATAS ( { "S" }, param_entity_view[entity_view_code] )
    VAR _fy     = TREATAS ( { 2025 }, param_fiscal_year[fiscal_year] )
    VAR _month  = TREATAS ( { 12 }, param_period[month_number] )
    VAR _tv     = TREATAS ( { "FY" }, param_time_view[time_view_code] )
    VAR _base   = TREATAS ( { "A" }, param_base_version[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_a  = TREATAS ( { "B" }, param_compare_a[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_b  = TREATAS ( { "PY" }, param_compare_b[choice_code] )
    VAR _ccy    = TREATAS ( { "USD" }, param_reporting_currency[currency_code] )
    VAR _fx     = TREATAS ( { "CC" }, param_fx_basis[fx_basis_code] )
    VAR _units  = TREATAS ( { "M" }, param_units[units_code] )
    VAR _members =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            FILTER (
                SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
                    dim_region[region_code]
                    ,dim_region[region_name]
                    ,_entity, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units
                    ,"@in_view", [Slice Member In View]
                    ,"@nr", CONVERT ( [Prof Net Revenue], DOUBLE )
                    ,"@nr_d_pct", CONVERT ( [Prof NR Δ % CC], DOUBLE )
                    ,"@gm", CONVERT ( [KPI Gross Margin %], DOUBLE )
                    ,"@cm", CONVERT ( [KPI CM %], DOUBLE )
                    ,"@cm_d_pp", CONVERT ( [Prof CM Δ pp], DOUBLE )
                    ,"@contrib", CONVERT ( [Prof Contribution], DOUBLE )
                    ,"@ebitda", CONVERT ( [Prof Adj EBITDA], DOUBLE )
                )
                ,[@in_view] = 1 && NOT ISBLANK ( dim_region[region_code] )
            )
            ,"@code", dim_region[region_code]
            ,"@name", dim_region[region_name]
            ,"@in_view", [@in_view]
            ,"@nr", [@nr]
            ,"@nr_d_pct", [@nr_d_pct]
            ,"@gm", [@gm]
            ,"@cm", [@cm]
            ,"@cm_d_pp", [@cm_d_pp]
            ,"@contrib", [@contrib]
            ,"@ebitda", [@ebitda]
        )
    VAR _total =
        CALCULATETABLE (
            ROW (
                "@code", "TOTAL"
                ,"@name", "Total"
                ,"@in_view", 1
                ,"@nr", CONVERT ( [Prof Net Revenue], DOUBLE )
                ,"@nr_d_pct", CONVERT ( [Prof NR Δ % CC], DOUBLE )
                ,"@gm", CONVERT ( [KPI Gross Margin %], DOUBLE )
                ,"@cm", CONVERT ( [KPI CM %], DOUBLE )
                ,"@cm_d_pp", CONVERT ( [Prof CM Δ pp], DOUBLE )
                ,"@contrib", CONVERT ( [Prof Contribution], DOUBLE )
                ,"@ebitda", CONVERT ( [Prof Adj EBITDA], DOUBLE )
            )
            ,_entity, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units
        )
EVALUATE
UNION ( _members, _total )
ORDER BY [@nr] DESC
